dishes.name: Herby Scrambled Eggs on Sourdough
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs with spinach and toasted sourdough
dishes.method: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper. Heat oil in a pan, wilt the spinach for a minute, then pour in the eggs and scramble gently until just set. Serve over toasted sourdough.
dishes.why: A warm, protein-rich start to the stretch that requires no pre-prepared batches.

dishes.name: Mackerel and Cucumber Toasts
dishes.title: Tinned mackerel on sourdough with sliced cucumber
dishes.method: Toast the bread. Flake the mackerel over the toast and top with thin slices of cucumber and a crack of black pepper.
dishes.why: A high-protein lunch that uses pantry staples while the main batch cooking is yet to happen.

dishes.name: Garlic Roast Chicken and Rice
dishes.title: Roasted chicken thighs with garlic broccoli and basmati rice
dishes.method: Place a portion of chicken, rice, and broccoli into a wide pan with a splash of water. Cover and heat over medium heat until steaming and hot throughout.
dishes.why: A complete meal with a loud vegetable and warm components as the coach requires.

dishes.name: Berry and Seed Yogurt Bowls
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with berry compote and sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Spoon the yogurt into bowls and top with the cold berry compote and seeds.
dishes.why: A quick, cold assembly that avoids the kitchen while the lodger is present.

dishes.name: Cold Lemon Chicken Rice Salad
dishes.title: Chicken and rice salad with lemon and herbs
dishes.method: Dice the cold chicken and mix with the rice. Dress with lemon juice, oil, and pepper. Serve in bowls.
dishes.why: Uses the pre-cooked batch for a large, muscle-fuelling lunch that needs no stove time.

dishes.name: One-Pot Tomato and Bean Stew
dishes.title: White bean and tomato stew with fresh spinach
dishes.method: Sauté garlic in oil, add tomatoes and beans. Simmer for 10 minutes, then stir in spinach until wilted. Serve hot in bowls.
dishes.why: A warm dinner that only uses one pot, making it easy to cook even with a busy kitchen.

dishes.name: Summer Berry Yogurt Pots
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with berry compote
dishes.method: Layer the yogurt and berry compote in small bowls or glasses.
dishes.why: Consistent, high-protein breakfast using the existing batch.

dishes.name: Tuna and White Bean Salad
dishes.title: Tinned tuna and cannellini bean salad with cucumber
dishes.method: Drain the tuna and beans. Mix with diced cucumber, olive oil, and plenty of black pepper.
dishes.why: A high-protein, large lunch that requires no cooking session.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Fish with Garlic Broccoli
dishes.title: White fish fillets with reheated garlic broccoli
dishes.method: Season the fish and sear in a hot pan with oil for 3 minutes per side. Reheat the broccoli in the same pan for the last 2 minutes.
dishes.why: Freshly cooked protein paired with a pre-prepared loud vegetable.

preparations.title: Herb Roasted Chicken Thighs
preparations.method: Rub chicken with oil, oregano, salt, and pepper. Roast at 200C for 30-35 minutes until the skin is crisp and cooked through.

preparations.title: Steamed Basmati Rice
preparations.method: Rinse rice. Add to a pot with double the volume of water and a pinch of salt. Bring to boil, then cover and simmer for 12 minutes. Turn off heat and let sit for 5 minutes.

preparations.title: Garlic Roasted Broccoli
preparations.method: Cut broccoli into florets. Toss with sliced garlic and oil. Roast on a tray at 200C for 20 minutes until tender and slightly charred.

preparations.title: Simmered Berry Compote
preparations.method: Place berries in a small saucepan over medium heat. Simmer for 10-15 minutes until they break down and the juices thicken slightly.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat the oven to 200C. Prepare the chicken and broccoli on separate trays and put them in. Start the rice on the stove. While things cook, simmer the berries in a small pot. Once the rice is done, fluff it and set aside. Remove the broccoli and chicken when ready, let them cool slightly, and box everything into the named containers.

member_portions.portion_note: Serve a larger share of the chicken and rice with the standard broccoli portion. For breakfast, add a spoonful of blackcurrant jam to the sourdough toast.
Serve the standard share of all components. Ensure all bread crusts are removed before serving.
Serve a larger share of chicken and rice. Ensure no orange-coloured vegetables or fennel-containing herbs are added to the plate.
Serve the standard share of all components. Provide hot sauce on the side for every meal.
